Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter

Class AntivirusBackend

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.AntivirusBackend
public final class AntivirusBackend extends Object
The AWT-free antivirus seam. The desktop ships no virus engine of its own, so - exactly like the recorder handing screen capture to ffmpeg and the media writer handing burning to xorriso - this backend honestly delegates scanning to an installed ClamAV. It resolves which scanner to drive (clamdscan talks to the fast clamd daemon; clamscan loads the database itself and always works standalone), builds the precise command lines, and parses their output into a ScanReport / VersionInfo.

Every method here is pure and side-effect free - no process is started - so the whole command / parser table is unit-testable headless. The thin, guarded ProcessBuilder launch lives in SecurityCenterPanel and is only ever reached from a user action.

ClamAV exit codes are 0 = clean, 1 = virus found, 2 = error. clamdscan with the daemon stopped still prints a SCAN SUMMARY (full of errors, no per-file lines); ScanReport exposes that as a failed run so the panel can fall back to clamscan.

    • scanCommand

      public static List<String> scanCommand(String scanner, String target, boolean recursive, boolean quarantine, String quarantineDir)
      Builds the scan command line. --infected keeps the output to just the threats (the SCAN SUMMARY counters are still printed), so scanning a large tree does not flood the UI with one OK line per file. When quarantine is set, infected files are moved (not deleted) into quarantineDir via ClamAV's --move.
      Parameters:
      scanner - the executable (clamscan or clamdscan)
      target - the file or folder to scan
      recursive - true to walk directories (--recursive)
      quarantine - true to move infected files aside
      quarantineDir - the destination folder for --move
      Returns:
      the argument list, never null; empty when a required input is blank

    • scanCommand

      public static List<String> scanCommand(String scanner, String target, boolean recursive, boolean quarantine, String quarantineDir, boolean infectedOnly)
      Builds the scan command line, choosing between a quiet and a streaming output mode. With infectedOnly set the --infected flag keeps the output to just the threats (the SCAN SUMMARY counters are still printed), so a large tree does not flood the caller with one OK line per file. Clearing it makes ClamAV print a line per file, which is what lets SecurityCenterPanel drive a determinate progress bar and a live "current file" read-out as it streams the output; the caller discards the OK lines rather than buffering them.
      Parameters:
      scanner - the executable (clamscan or clamdscan)
      target - the file or folder to scan
      recursive - true to walk directories (--recursive)
      quarantine - true to move infected files aside
      quarantineDir - the destination folder for --move
      infectedOnly - true to add --infected (quiet), false to emit a line per file (streaming progress)
      Returns:
      the argument list, never null; empty when a required input is blank

    • parseScanOutput

      public static ScanReport parseScanOutput(List<String> lines, int exitCode)
      Parses a scanner's combined stdout/stderr into a ScanReport. The parser recognises per-file status lines (path: OK, path: SIGNATURE FOUND, path: reason ERROR), general ERROR: lines, and the SCAN SUMMARY counters, while ignoring the LibClamAV Warning banner and the Loading:/Compiling: progress lines clamscan prints while it builds the database.
      Parameters:
      lines - the merged process output (may be null)
      exitCode - the process exit code
      Returns:
      the parsed report, never null

    • parseFreshclamProgress

      public static OptionalInt parseFreshclamProgress(String line)
      Parses a whole-file download percentage out of a freshclam line such as Downloading daily.cvd [ 45%]. Returns empty when the line carries no NN% token, so the caller can leave the bar indeterminate rather than inventing progress.
      Parameters:
      line - one freshclam output line (may be null)
      Returns:
      the percentage clamped to 0..100, or empty when there is none

    • parseLoadProgress

      public static OptionalInt parseLoadProgress(String line)
      Parses a percentage out of a clamscan database-load line such as Loading: 3s, ETA: 0s [===> ] 4.10M/8.68M sigs (or the matching Compiling: line), computed from the a/b count ratio. Only the load/compile phase is recognised; anything else yields empty so the caller keeps the bar indeterminate.
      Parameters:
      line - one clamscan output line (may be null)
      Returns:
      the percentage clamped to 0..100, or empty when not a load line
